summary: A colleague catches a member between meetings to begin discussing a vote.
realLife: Susan Collins recalled talking with Lisa Murkowski and John McCain on the Senate floor before the 2017 health vote. McCain told the two senators in person that he agreed with their position.
inGame: The hallway-colleague circumstance stages vote-asked for a serving member.

turns.what: The member hears which provision is disputed and asks for the text at their desk.
turns.pulledBy: The next meeting is starting and the colleague has no copy along.
turns.writesBack: The open request identifies the provision to review.

turns.what: By the time the two members meet again, the disputed sentence has been struck from the draft.
turns.pulledBy: The clerk has published a newer version since the hallway conversation.
turns.writesBack: The negotiators close the request against the earlier text and turn to the remaining clauses.
